name: refactor_compose_duplicate_env
description: Extracts environment variables duplicated across two docker-compose services into a shared source
prompts: docker-compose.yml defines an 'app' service and a 'worker' service that both duplicate the exact same three environment variables inline (DATABASE_URL, API_KEY, LOG_LEVEL). Refactor docker-compose.yml to eliminate this duplication: extract the shared variables into a single .env file referenced by both services via env_file (or, alternatively, a YAML anchor/alias shared by both services), while preserving the effective values each service receives. Do not remove either service.

setup_files.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://appuser:apppass@db:5432/appdb
      - API_KEY=changeme-api-key
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
  worker:
    image: myorg/worker:latest
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://appuser:apppass@db:5432/appdb
      - API_KEY=changeme-api-key
      - LOG_LEVEL=info

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"

x-shared-env: &shared-env
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://appuser:apppass@db:5432/appdb
  API_KEY: changeme-api-key
  LOG_LEVEL: info

services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      <<: *shared-env
  worker:
    image: myorg/worker:latest
    environment:
      <<: *shared-env
